name: Pudgy Penguins
description: Pudgy Penguins NFT collection launched their $PENGU token. Holders and community members may be eligible for ongoing rewards.
requirements: Hold Pudgy Penguins NFT (or Lil Pudgys)

steps.title: Check Your Eligibility
steps.description: If you own Pudgy Penguins or Lil Pudgys NFTs, you're likely eligible. Check the official announcement for snapshot dates and claim windows.

steps.title: Connect Wallet and Claim
steps.description: When the claim portal opens, connect the wallet holding your NFTs to claim your $PENGU tokens. Always verify the official URL.
steps.tips: Never connect to unofficial claim sites - they are scams

name: Blur Season 3
description: Blur NFT marketplace runs loyalty seasons. Active traders and bidders earn points convertible to $BLUR tokens.

steps.title: Connect Wallet to Blur
steps.description: Visit Blur.io and connect your MetaMask or other Web3 wallet.

steps.title: Trade and Earn Points
steps.description: Buy, sell, or bid on NFTs. Higher trading volume and active bidding earn more points. Points convert to $BLUR in future seasons.

name: Magic Eden Diamonds
description: Magic Eden NFT marketplace rewards program. Trade NFTs to earn diamonds, redeemable for future token rewards.

steps.title: Create Magic Eden Account
steps.description: Sign up at Magic Eden and connect your wallet (supports Solana, Ethereum, Polygon, Bitcoin Ordinals).

steps.title: Trade and Earn Diamonds
steps.description: Buy or sell NFTs on the platform. Complete daily tasks to earn bonus diamonds that count toward rewards.
steps.tips: Start with low-cost Solana NFTs to minimize risk while farming
